title: Just the wall
hook: Painter at 10 am. ONE wall. Rs 1,500.

beats.say: Painter's at ten. Show me this one wall in sage green. Nothing else.
beats.show: Painter's at 10. Show me this ONE wall in sage green. Nothing else.

screen.title: my-room.jpg
screen.body:
Room: 10 x 10
Left wall: paint this one
1 bed, 1 window, 1 plastic chair
Painter: 10 am, Rs 1,500

beats.say: Of course. But first, how does green make you feel?

screen.title: Your wall (after a 900 word note on green)
screen.body:
Wall: sage green
Room: now 20 x 20
Window: now a balcony
Plastic chair: now a velvet armchair
Light: golden hour

beats.say: I'm so sorry. Everything else stays exactly the same this time.

screen.title: Your wall (v3)
screen.body:
Wall: sage green
Sea view: kept
Bed: deleted (unused)
Chair: deleted (unused)
Room: empty

beats.say: Done! I also sent the nice one to the family group!

screen.title: Mum
screen.body:
Beta itna bada flat?? Sea facing??

Sharma aunty ko bhej diya, rishta wale puchh rahe hain.

caption:
asked for one green wall. got a sea facing flat, no bed, and a rishta.

claude, codex or gemini: who gets your wall?
